candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Controls Tutorial
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing interactive desktop shortcut highlights for calling, hiding, and speaking to the pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails complain about confusion over controlling, hiding, or interacting with the pet after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Learn how to easily summon, hide, and interact with your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop-off at finish step (35.2%) and multiple support tickets, but requires full screen redesign.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Pre-Check Screen
candidates.change: Insert a pre-check screen before pet selection to test display scaling and desktop rendering compatibility.
candidates.why: Support emails report pets failing to appear on desktop or custom pet generation breaking on certain display setups.

new_display_check.headline: Checking Desktop Compatibility
new_display_check.body: We are verifying screen settings to ensure your desktop pet renders cleanly.

guard.reason: Adding a new technical compatibility screen inside onboarding without removing required steps is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets 39.1% adoption drop-off and display bugs, but requires creating a brand new screen.

candidates.title: Pet Playbook Mini-Game While Waiting
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive pet training mini-flow on the waiting screen while the 3D pet model is generated.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to drop off while waiting.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Being Created!
waiting.body: While you wait, explore quick mini-activities to learn how to care for your pet.

guard.reason: Adding mini-activities during the wait while preserving the pet creation notice is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme home waiting times (mean 2336s), but building a mini-game flow is high effort.

candidates.title: Streamlined Path First Entry
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding so users pick their onboarding path immediately before reading the full background story.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is unusually high (514s), suggesting users get bogged down before selecting a path.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Account Recovery & Sync Notice
candidates.change: Add clear copy explaining that signing in anchors pet progress to prevent data resets across logins.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with a different account method.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Log in to link your pet to your account and keep progress synced across sessions.
sign_in.hint: Use your primary account so your pet data is safely backed up.

guard.reason: Adding explanatory copy to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 8 support tickets and copy-only change makes it low cost, though sign_in step loss is lower.

candidates.title: Step-by-Step Generation Status Tracker
candidates.change: Show granular progress indicators and estimated time remaining during pet rendering on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The high waiting duration (mean 2336s) leads to drop-offs when users do not know how far along rendering is.

guard.reason: Showing progress and time estimates during a real wait is allowed under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high home step wait times with clear feedback indicators at moderate effort.

candidates.title: Official Pet Adoption Milestone Badge
candidates.change: Display a celebratory adoption certificate card with an official badge when completing pet naming.
candidates.why: The adoption stage conversion is 60.9%; boosting perceived reward increases completion sentiment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Congratulations! Your new companion is officially adopted and ready for setup.

guard.reason: Replacing the required official stamp with a milestone badge loses the job/element required on the adoption certificate.

candidates.title: Split-Screen Pet Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switch the pick_friend screen layout to split-screen to showcase full pet previews alongside choice options.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a high median time of 89s, indicating slow decision-making.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Preview pet behaviors and animations side-by-side to make your choice.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend screen layout to split-screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets biggest step loss (adoption 60.9%) and high decision time (89s) via layout improvements.

candidates.title: Desktop Notification & Quick Summon Setup
candidates.change: Prompt users on the finish screen to enable desktop tray notifications and hotkeys for fast pet access.
candidates.why: Users routinely submit tickets after onboarding explaining they do not know how to interact with or reveal their pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Enable system tray shortcuts so your pet is always accessible with one click.

guard.reason: Adding desktop notification settings to the home intro screen during onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence and finish step drop-off (35.2%), requiring quick setup prompts.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidelines & Validator
candidates.change: Add photo selection guidelines and explicit tips to ensure uploaded images produce high-quality pets.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visual outputs.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: For the best render, use clear, well-lit photos facing forward.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid dark or blurry images so your pet model renders cleanly.

guard.reason: Adding photo upload quality hints on the upload_photos screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Helps adoption conversion drop by validating uploads to prevent generation errors.

decisions.title: Desktop Pet Control Walkthrough
decisions.outcome: lost: did not hold up in re-test
